summary: JouwWeb is website builder, founded in 2018. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: JouwWeb is an Eindhoven website builder that lets people make sites without coding, and an IND recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: A Dutch company based in Eindhoven that builds a no-code website builder.
Its data role offers an independent position with a lot of responsibility and direct contact with the board.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (JouwWeb B.V.).

worth_knowing.text: Current roles are mid and senior level; the data role asks for 4-8+ years of experience.
